metadata.description: mailsort: a portable, provider-neutral email triage plugin for Claude Code and Cowork. Gmail and Microsoft 365, Composio or native connectors.

plugins.name: mailsort
plugins.description: Sort any inbox into ten stable categories, surface only what a human must answer, draft context-checked replies, brief the owner each morning, sweep backlogs, and export client-side filter rules. Never sends or deletes.
